title: 간판·메뉴의 외래어: 사전에는 어떻게 써요?
objective: You can work out which English word a Hangul loanword comes from and choose the dictionary spelling using three simple rules.
summary: Learners read English loanwords in Hangul on signs and menus and learn the dictionary spelling.
note: The common spellings come from real signs and menus. You need to recognize them, but use the dictionary spelling when you write.

task.title: Read and fix loanwords
task.line: Read each Korean part, then write the English word, choose or correct the spelling, or answer the question as asked.

sections.heading: Two spellings, one word
paragraphs: In Korean, the same loanword often appears in two ways: the dictionary spelling (표준 표기) and a spelling people often use on signs and menus. Read both easily, but use the dictionary spelling in forms, reports and tests.

Three quick rules: ① Usually no ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ, ㅉ, even if people say the word strongly: 버스, 카페 (not 뻐스, 까페). A few long-established words such as 껌 (gum) and 빵 (bread) are exceptions. ② No ㅑ, ㅕ, ㅛ, ㅠ after ㅈ or ㅊ: 주스 (not 쥬스). ③ A final consonant (받침) is only ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅅ or ㅇ: 로봇, 커피숍 (not 로봍, 커피숖).

sections.heading: How to read an unknown loanword

steps.en: ㅍ may be f, ㅂ may be v (파일 = file)
Guess the word, then check the context

sections.heading: Dictionary spelling vs. what you often see

items.text: You often see 메세지, but the dictionary writes 메시지.
Shops often write 초콜렛; the dictionary form ends in 릿.
Menus often write 소세지, but the dictionary writes 소시지.
Shop signs often say 악세사리; the dictionary form starts with 액.
You often see 바베큐, but the dictionary writes 바비큐.
People often write 렌트카; the dictionary form is 렌터카.
Bakeries often write 케익 or 케잌; the dictionary writes 케이크.
Menus often write 쥬스, but rule ② says no ㅠ after ㅈ.

exercises: Write the English word: ① 패션 ② 비타민 ③ 프린터
Choose the dictionary spelling: ① (텔레비전 / 텔레비젼) ② (돈까스 / 돈가스) ③ (인터넽 / 인터넷)
Read the notice and answer in English: [안내] 이번 주 토요일 오후 2시, 3층 세미나실에서 '스마트폰 사진 찍기' 워크숍이 열립니다. 노트북은 가져오지 않아도 됩니다. ① What is the workshop about? ② What do you not need to bring?
Each sign has one word that is not in dictionary spelling. Write the correct spelling: ① 음료는 써비스입니다. ② 다음 달 수업 스케쥴 ③ 초코칲 쿠키 새로 나왔어요!
